denominator: Regulatory lot area; a plan label, APN, or approximate traverse is not silently promoted to exact legal lot area.
historical_use: Project-fact semantics only in this packet because RM-2-5 has no base-zone maximum; no current rule is substituted for the historical table.
multiple_buildings: Aggregate without overlapping or double-counting nested uses such as garages inside a parent building outline.
numerator: Aggregate qualifying footprint of all structures, measured at outer exterior walls or support structure, after express exclusions.

treatments.accessory_structures: Count when their exterior walls or supports create qualifying structure footprint.
treatments.below_grade_structures: Qualifying underground parking, first stories, and basements at no more than three feet above grade are excluded under the express predicates.
treatments.covered_projections: Count unless an express Section 113.0240 exclusion is supported.
treatments.garages_and_carports: Ordinary above-grade footprint counts; qualifying underground/low-above-grade portions follow the express exclusion.
treatments.pools: Excluded from this structure-footprint numerator absent a separate qualifying structure.
treatments.roofed_patios_or_decks: Potentially excluded only under the section's roofed-area predicates, including the applicable exterior-wall condition; otherwise count.
treatments.solar_system_exterior_portions: Excluded under the express solar-system provision.
treatments.trash_enclosure: Classification depends on roof, wall, and support facts; a site allocation alone is insufficient.
treatments.uncovered_hardscape: Excluded because it is not structure footprint.
